depiction.primary_object: desktop monitor or TV screen on a short base
modifiers: right frame edge turning inward into a left-pointing arrow
depiction.composition: single object, front view, continuous line forming screen and inward arrow

readings.meaning: TV or monitor input source selection (AV / HDMI input)
cast, stream, or mirror media into a TV or external display
remote desktop connection or logging into a workstation
import or transfer files onto a computer

ambiguity: Can be mistaken for the outward-pointing export box if the arrow direction and monitor stand are missed, or for the camera with a double arrow if the bottom stand is confused with a top camera hump.

modifier_semantics.modifier: inward left-pointing arrow entering the screen
modifier_semantics.meaning: input, incoming signal, casting to display, or logging into a machine

task_intents: switch or configure TV input source

reasoning: The icon is the standard IEC/AV symbol for television or monitor video input (a screen frame whose side turns inward as an arrow), also widely understood as casting to a display or logging into a remote computer. It fits tasks around hooking up HDMI/AV inputs, screen mirroring, and remote desktop access, though it can be confused with a generic login or a plain monitor icon.
